name: farmacia-amancio-fernandez
description: Web + API + Admin de Farmacia Amancio Fernández (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm run env && npm run db:up && npm -w apps/api run db:migrate && npm -w apps/api run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm -w apps/api run start:dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm -w apps/api run start:prod" "npm -w apps/web run start"
